title: ⚠️ Warnings and steps — {title}
intro: Warnings are given with /warn (or «اخطار») or from the «Warned» list. When a member's active warnings reach a step, Aegis applies it.
reset: 🔁 Clear warnings after the last step: {state}
audit_note: 🕵️ Audit Mode is on: steps are only reported, not applied.
steps_prompt: Send the steps, one per line: warnings action [duration]. Actions: mute, restrict, kick, ban (or سکوت، محدود، اخراج، بن). Example: 3 mute 1d 5 ban
steps_err_action: Line {line}: the action must be mute, restrict, kick or ban.
steps_err_count: Line {line}: the number of warnings must be 1 to 50.
steps_err_order: Line {line}: each step needs more warnings than the one before.
steps_err_duration: Line {line}: the duration isn't valid (1 min to 366 days, e.g. 30m, 2h, 1d).
removed_last: ➖ The last warning of {name} was removed.
